item.name: CodeSystem

request.name: Retrieves a list of code systems

description.content: Retrieves a list of code systems matching the provided search criteria.

query.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.
